translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: Rkx Ngr Nzodatingr Mangr-nzangiongr
Mzli kc Jiszs narlaszpe-ngrde Mangr-nzangiongr Yawe, vzmgr bade sc tqlxtipebzkrng kxmu nzlrmztiongr nzrwzngr.
Rpim Jiszs bagr kx, “Napi-angidrbo bamu kx da lcng amrlx tqmcamu, x Mangr-nzangiongr lc trnatu-alou. Trpnzngr rplz ngrde kx nablio me yc-ngrde. Murde sa naodati enqmi rmung kalr.”
Rkx Ngr Vea X Nzkxpungr Kxkqlu

Kx krlzbzkr kc Newz ngr Nc Olivi, Jiszs sc tqwxbupe elr, mrlcde nzmcpz Mangr-nzangiongr. Zbz kzdung kztegrng sc tzvz-lrpipebzng mrkc tqwxbu-ngrde. Nzrpibzlr kx, “Pim ena bagr mzli kc naodatingr Mangr-nzangiongr, x rkx kznikeng namc nakrlztingr mzli r nzyzlu-krme mzli kc nayrkrpx-ngrbz nrlc.”
Rpim Jiszs bagr kx, “Aclvetio-lzbqamu mz da lcng. Bzkq rlr-ngrbzmu mz leplz nzapokiati-krdr nimu mz da kznikeng naprtz.
Ncblo nakqlung sa navzmqng mz drtqnge, narpibzlr mz leplz kx, ‘Ninge Mevalu Kxnzmcpx.’ X leplz nakqlung kalr nalxngitilr nidr mz nzpokia-krdr.
“X mou, bzkq nelzmu tzprlzm mz nzxlr-krmu natqdr dalr nzotangr mz vea kx esotrpq x nrpa ngr vea kx ycm rlru. Da kxnzmulr lcng naprtzti-kaing, a' trngiu drtwr ngr nzyrkrpxpe-krbz nrlc.
Murde mrkcng kqlu mz nrlc sa napnz-lzbqng. Dzbi kxetu sa navzmqng, x nengq kxetu sa navz-kzpqng.
A' da lcng tqprtzting nzapulr nztangqgx-zlwzkr olvz kxyr, mzli kc tqvz-ebir-ngrm nimz ngr doa kxtopwz, x sc tqrmika ate.

“Mzli lc sa na-aetqbzlr drtqmu, x sa nalolvzlr nimu, x nanibqlr nimu. Murde leplz mz natq amrlx x drtc' amrlx mz nrlc kcng tzmwati drtwrdr ninge sa namwati kz drtwrdr nimu mz nzngini-krmu leplz nengeng.
Mz mzli r nzkxpungr lcng, kzdung leplz kcng tzvz-nqblq-kailr ninge, sa trnalxngitilru ninge. Zbz mz nzmwatikr drtwrdr leplz nengeng, sa na-aprcbzlr nidr mz kxdrka'-ngrng.
X profet kxnzpokiang nakqlung. X sa naesabrtilr leplz mz nzmailz-rbr-krdr nidr mz nzalvztrngr angidr.
Mzli lc, nqmq kr leplz kxdrka'-ngrng sa naetunepx mz nzbatr-krbzlr nzbaokr nivz mz nrlc.
A' nimu kcng tztu-amqngi-zvzng mz nzrlxngiti-krmu krlzbzle mz nzbz-krmu, sa na-arlapx Gct nimu.
“X mzli lc, leplz nengeng sa nayapwxtipxbzlr Nrpakxmrlz mz leplz ngr drtc' x natq amrlx mz nrlc, kx Gct vectrple leplz mz nzngini-krde King rdr murde narlapxng, x nrlc kc tqyrkrpx ate.”
Rkx Ngr Nzodatingr Jerusalem

Rpi-mop Jiszs bagr kx, “Kxdrka'ngr kxmyapxbz kc tqtrka-esz'ngr sa navzm, mz nzatutr-krde da kx yro Daniel mz buk scde. X nimu kcng tzrlwxlr da lc nakrlz-angidramu drtwr ngrde. Murde Kxdrka'ngr lc sa natuom Mrkc Tqtr Mangr-nzangiongr Yawe, a' trtakitrdeu nide nztuo-krmle elr.
Mzli lc nimu kcng tzmncng Judiz nangrlrlzamu mz newz murde namnc-kapq-ngrnamu nzodangr kc tqycpe pipz nzkaputr-krmle.
Nzmu kx tqmncome mz nibr ma nyzm, bzkq asaq nzvoo-krme x bzkq otrpeq dztum ma nyzm. A' ngrlrtx pnz.
X nzmu kx tqwzq mz nrlanc, bzkq vzpeq ma nyzm mz nzoti-krm lrpzm, x sc tqngrlr-ateq.
Agrmqng olvz kcng tzyrng x krkcng tzayqng itoto, murde rblxtile nidr nzngrlrlz-ani-krdr mz newz mz nzmnc-kapq-krdr.
Krka'-ngrbzmu mz Gct murde ma nzrdwasz-krmu tqkaputrp mz Sabat kc tqngi zbq kxnzamati o mz mzli r zbao, mzli kc nrlc tqbao-zlwz-ngrde.
Murde ztrka ngr nzkxpungr lcng sa namyaszpxlr ztrka amrlx abzo mz mzli kc ayrnrngr tqwzngr Gct nrlc krlzmle mzli ka. X trpengr nzwrde kxnamule lc kx naprtz kalr.
Gct aotipe drtwrde nzamrbcnetr-krmle mzli lc, murde leplz ma tzyrkrtxtrng. X amrbcnetrple mzli lc mz nzokatr-krde leplz kcng tqmcpxpeleng.
“Mzli lcde, nzmu kx tzrpibz leplz bamu kx, ‘Obqki lcmonr Kxnzmcpx kc tqmnc mrkc!’ o ‘Obqkim ka nide se tqmnckibzle ka!’ bzkq lxngitiamu nidr.
Murde mevalu kxnzpokiang x profet kxnzalvztr-rbrng sa navzmqng. X na-aleting rkx x da kx nakctipxng mz nzesabrti-krdr leplz kcng tqmcpxpeng Gct, nzmu nakrlzlr nzyatr-krbzlr.
Lalztq-angidramu! Napi-kaipo da lcng bamu x mzli rdr kc tqvz-atem.
Mz nzmu-krde lcde, nzmu kx tzrpibz leplz bamu kx, ‘Obqki lcmonr Kxnzmcpx kc tqmnc lzke!’ o ‘Obqkim ka nide se tqmncpxm ma ka!’ bzkq lxngitiamu nidr.
Murde ninge Mrlx Leplz nzyzlu-krmc sa naotxpx mz mzpu. Sa na-apule nzrpnapxkr bzlrpc mz nzayzlrpx-krde bongavz, abzo mz kzdq nrlarde krlzbzle kzdq nrlarde.
X mz nzmc-krdr da lc, me mnc-ngrne naopxbz mz leplz amrlx.”
Rkx Ngr Nzvz-krm Mrlx Leplz
Rpi-mop Jiszs bagr kx, “Mz nibr mzli r nzkxpungr lcng, ‘Gct sa na-aycngrlrtile dalr bongavz kcng tzmatq amrlx. Nepi nawx-nzlongr x temz trnapnzpxu. X vri sa natatio-lxblrmqng mz bongavz.’

Ninge Mrlx Leplz. X mzli lc, sa namclz rkx rnge mz bongavz. X kxtrnzrlxngitiung amrlx sa namclr Mrlx Leplz mz nzvz-krmc mz nabz dcbz ngr bongavz mz zluli kxetu x zmatq. X sa nayrning murde nzkrlzlr kx mzli trnaboipeu x sc tzayrplapxpeng.
X mzli lc, trpu kxetu nayrni x sa na-atwzlrpx-ngrne enjrl nengeng mz nrlc tulvzo. X sa navzmimlr leplz neng Gct kcng tqmcpxleng.”
Rkx Ngr Nc Fiki

Zbz rpi-mop Jiszs bagr kx, “Mwx natwzamu drtwr ngr nzplcokr leu r nc fiki. Mrka Israel mzli kc namc-ngrnamu nrlar nc fiki tzpooti-ngrdr x nzyrlqbzlr leu rdr kxmrna, sc tqkrlzpeamu kx mzli r nrpr ngr nranc sa tqesopem.
Mz nqmq lcpwz, mzli kc namc-ngrnamu kx da lcng tqpibo bamu sc tqtutrpemqng, sc tqkrlzpe-kzamu kx mzli r nzvz-krmc esotrpem.
Nakrlz-angidramu kx da lcng amrlx nangidati-kaing, x leplz kcng tzmncng mz nrlc sc tzyrkrtr-ateng.
Kxmule-esz' bongavz x nrlc sa nayrkrpxng kalr, a' natqngeng trtxpnzngr nzyrkrpx-krdr, murde sa nangidating amrlx.”
Naoliqti-zvzku Nzyzlu-krm Jiszs
Rpi-mop Jiszs bagr kx, “Trpnzngr kxrkrlz zbq x nabz nepi kc nayzlu-ngrmc. Trnzkrlzlru enjrl ngr Heven amrlx x trkrlz-kzwxu, a' krlz txpwz Trtenge esz'-krde.
Nayzlumc mzli kc leplz napxtxpx-ngrdr nzlalztqngr mz natq Gct, da kc tqwaile mz mzli nyz Noa.
Mzli lcde leplz nzmung, nzyrlzng, x nzpxtxpx-ngrdr nzlalztqngr mz natq Gct, vz vz krlzmle mzli kc Noa badr mrlxdeng tzdwatr-ngrdr mz lcsu kc etu. X nubla kc tqvo-atem.
Murde kxdrka'-ngrng lcng trnzkrlzlru kx Gct sa naodatile nidr, a' dcpxpengr drtwrdr nzvo-krm nubla mz nzaboo-krde nidr. X kxnamu-kzle lc mz zbq kc nayzlu-ngrmc.
Mzli lc ncblo nzling nawz-lxblrng mz nrlanc kxesz'. Navzmipe Gct krkc tqtubq. X narlaszpe krkc trvz-nqblqleu ninge, mz nzodatingr nide.
X olvz nzling naoliq-lxblrng mz dakxnzng. Navzmipe kc x narlaszpe kc.
Mz nzmu-krde lcde, oliq-zvzamu murde trkrlzwamuu zbq kxnanginide.
Ncblo kx pna da trnzkrlzu zbq kx napna-ngrde da brma. Mz nzmu-krde lcde naoliqti zvz nzvz-krmle.
X mz nqmq lcpwz, naoliqti-zvzamu nzvz-krmc, murde ninge Mrlx Leplz sa navzmc mz mzli kx trnakrlzwamuu.”
Kxnzawz Kx Brti Drtwr Kxetu Rde

Jiszs rpi-mople bagr kx, “Napibo bamu kxmu kxnzawz nenge kx brti drtwrnge. Sa na-apule kc kxetu kx aprcbzle mz kzdq kxnzawz nede mz nzaclve-krde kztedeng x mz nzapu-krde nidr. Zbz sc tqvzpe mz kzdq nrlc. Kxnzawz kxyrplapx x brti drtwr kxetu rde sa navz-nqblq-zvzle natq kxetu lc.
Mz nzmu-krde lcde, mzli kc navz-ngrm kxetu rde, kxnzawz lc sa na-abrtzlvzle nzale-krde nzwz-krde.
Da angidr lc napibo bamu. Kxetu kc sa nayrlqle kxnzawz lc mz nzaclve-krbzle dztudeng amrlx.
A' nzmu nanginide kxnzawz kxtrka, sa narpile mz drtwrde kx, ‘Kxetu rnge trpnzngr nzvz-ani-krmle.’
Zbz sc tqabzope-kzle nzibrti-krde kztedeng. A' nide kc tqmu x tqangqnguti-lzbq-ngrde nzrmnqngr.
A' kxetu kc yzlum mz mzli kx trpnzu drtwr kxnzawz lc.
Zbz kxetu kc sa na-ayrplapx-zlwzle nide x na-atwzlr-ngrde nide mrkc leplz nayrni-alo-ngrdr mz nzetqkr drtq x namadqtilr nqngidr mz zngya, badr leplz kx narpi-ngrbz kxnzrlxngiting.”
